newsitem.title: GREECE: GREEK GOVT REVISES 96 REAL GDP GROWTH UP.
newsitem.headline: GREEK GOVT REVISES 96 REAL GDP GROWTH UP.

text.p: The national economy ministry has revised its real GDP growth upward to 2.6 percent from 2.5 percent and projects the general government budget deficit to fall to 7.6 percent of GDP from 9.0 percent in 1995, a government source said.
Greece's programme to align its economy with the rest of the EU projects a general government budget deficit at 7.6 percent of GDP and real GDP growth at 1.7 percent.
National Economy Minister Yannos Papandoniou is giving a news conference on the economy. --Dimitris Kontogiannis, Athens Newsroom +301 3311812-4
